source: User-provided screenshot of last remote turn failure

error.message: Error while downloading file. Upstream status code: 503.

interpretation: The remote turn failed while its file-fetch stage requested a URL and an upstream server responded 503. The wrapper reports 400/invalid_value. The screenshot contains no requested URL or filename, so the particular host/file and exact upstream cause cannot be determined. This is separate from the logged GitHub Godot HTTP 500 CI download.
retry: Retryable after upstream recovery or with a refreshed download URL if required. No repeat of the unidentified request is needed to resume this project, because all required art/engine/reports survived locally and were verified.
image_publication: User phone screenshot preserved locally only; error text can be reported in PR without publishing the whole screenshot.
